groups.name: legacy-unseeded
groups.note: no `v`, no seed → drawBrushSegment rolls Math.random; hashed for information only, never gates

groups.name: legacy-seeded
groups.note: no `v`, seeded → pointRand; eraser variation 0 (its branch never gets a rand)

groups.name: v2-catalog
groups.note: v:2 for every brush with a catalog dab, sizes 12/40/90, blue @1 + red @0.7 crossing

groups.name: v3-natural-dry
groups.note: v:3 oil/acrylic with the inline dab embedded, dry

groups.name: v3-natural-wet
groups.note: v:3 oil/acrylic wet:true riding a v2 gouache under-layer (mix-map pickup)

groups.name: smudge-legacy
groups.note: brush smudge (no `v`, strength 0.6 / 0.3) over a fill-rect red|blue field

groups.name: symmetry-radial8
groups.note: radial 8 copies: pins the 4-buffer cap quirk (copies 5-8 replay on the legacy segment path)

groups.name: overflow
groups.note: strokes spanning > 2200 px so the 2048² buffer cap banks mid-stroke chunks

groups.name: shapes
groups.note: drawShape line / rect / ellipse, stroked and filled

groups.name: text
groups.note: drawText with system-ui — stable per machine, differs across OS font stacks

groups.name: v3-sprites
groups.note: Stage 2: v:3 marker/pencil/crayon/paint/gouache/watercolor/oil/acrylic/glow with the inline dab embedded, sizes 12/40/90, blue @1 + red @0.7 crossing

groups.name: v3-marker-multiply
groups.note: v:3 marker (blend multiply): blue x yellow crossing, red @0.8 through both, white (luma guard → source-over)

groups.name: v3-water-glaze
groups.note: v:3 watercolor: dry yellow over blue (multiply glaze) + wet blue over a v3 gouache under-layer (pickup 0.35)

groups.name: v3-symmetry-wash
groups.note: settings.symmetry quad (4 copies) of a v:3 watercolor stroke

groups.name: v3-overflow-wash
groups.note: v:3 watercolor spanning > 2200 px so the 2048² buffer cap banks mid-stroke chunks

groups.name: v3-pigment
groups.note: Stage 3: v:3 oil/acrylic/paint/gouache (mixModel km) dry + wet across a v3 gouache under-layer, and a wet carry-recovery stroke through a fill-rect patch onto blank paper
